verdict.rationale: Gitea is a self-hostable git service that can run on your own servers. Code and data therefore stay on infrastructure you control, which implies the vendor never receives it for AI training. However, nothing in the evidence explicitly addresses AI training, and the managed cloud offering has no documented data-use policy. Missing for 10: an explicit no-AI-training data policy (especially for the managed service), documented controls to block AI crawlers or scrapers on public instances, and independent corroboration.
